titlePage.label: Title page
titlePage.p: "Zigeunermärchen" / af Goethes "Geschichte Gottfriedens v: Berlichingen." / for Solo, Chor og Orchester.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in brown cardboard. Written in brown ink. Paper: 20 staves. Paginated by Hartmann at top of the pages starting on first music page. Paginated in foreign hand at the bottom of the pages, starting on the title page. The two last pages blank. Minor corrections in Hartmann's hand and additions in pencil in foreign hand concerning a later performance. End-dated: "16.8.1859".

Bound in cardboard. Written in brown ink. Paper: 12 staves. With minor corrections in pencil. Title on the first music page: "Zigeunersang / af Goethes 'Geschichte Gottfriedens v. Berlichingen' / comp: for Solo, Chor og Orchester / I:P:E: Hartmann". End-dated: "12/6.59."

Bound in green cloth with the monogram of King Christian X. Written in brown ink. Paper: 14 staves. In foreign hand (S.A.E. Hagen?): "J.P.E. Hartmann / Originalmanuskript til / "Zigeunermährchen" / Klaverudtog". In a different hand: "8 Plader / haster ikke / Bagved et Par Blyantsskitser af J.P.E. Hartmann". Pagination pp. 1-15 starting at the verso of the title page; p. 13 blank. On pp. 14-15 sketches in pencil for unidentified works by Hartmann. On p. 12 end-dating: "16/7 63." With minor additions in pencil.
